svg.title: GPTpatient stateful single-session target architecture
svg.desc: A customer-authenticated Nuxt client connects to one modular TypeScript API. The API creates an immutable scenario seed, appends validated patient-history expansions during clinician-led turns, and manages session-scoped encounter state, assessment, tests, exams, transcript or full audio modes, and an append-only event ledger in PostgreSQL. Redis is optional for multi-replica coordination. OpenAI Responses and Realtime provide model and audio capabilities.
svg.text: GPTpatient · stateful patient encounter
One authenticated session · fixed case truth · bounded unpredictability · persistent patient history
GREENFIELD TARGET

text.tspan: patient details may grow from the scenario during history taking; the API validates and appends them before delivery.

History-taking conversation
Ask questions; receive grounded patient replies.

Encounter actions
Order supported tests; review released results.
Start abdominal or pelvic exam mode.
Patient consent / decline and exam findings.
Assessment mode cues
“Begin assessment” → clinician synthesis
“Complete assessment” → feedback / debrief
Audible confirmation + visible buttons for each phase.
Two independent audio modes
Transcript: mic/typed text → patient text + optional TTS.
Full Audio: streamed speech-in / speech-out.
Both keep transcript and action events in app state.
PRIVATE BOUNDARY
No API key, Redis access, or hidden answer key.
Application API · modular Express / TypeScript
Auth · entitlement checks · session coordinator · provider adapters
1 · Setup lane · bounded, non-interactive
Create fixed scenario seed + personality once.
Validate case truth, supported results, and history clues.
Setup retries return the same seed for the same request.
2 · Live turn lane · latency-sensitive
Doctor asks → patient naturally elaborates from a profile clue.
Validate + append new facts → deliver answer/audio → unlock.
Separate budgets, concurrency, timeout, metrics, and back-pressure.
3 · Encounter state machine · API is authority
intake → history → exam / orders → assessment → debrief
Validate cues, consent, supported actions, findings, and transitions.
Model may propose history facts; API commits them, not case truth/results.
Evaluator scores submitted synthesis after completion, off turn path.
Server-controlled customer policy
Luna · Terra · Sol model tiers; freeze choice per session.
Customer entitlements select transcript / full audio availability.
OpenAI IDs, patient truth, and provider credentials stay private.
ONE APP SESSION ↔ ONE FIXED SEED + APPENDED FACTS ↔ ONE PROVIDER CONTEXT
Responses Conversation is model context, not the app database.
Full Audio bridge records transcript projection + state events.

Tenant-scoped · versioned · replayable
